# Biochar amendment in a humid tropical maize-cowpea rotation

Okafor, C. (2023). *Journal of Synthetic Agronomy* 16(1), 12–25.

The experiment ran at the Nsukka Research Farm in Nigeria, where mean annual
temperature is 26.1 °C. Maize and cowpea were grown in rotation across all
plots.

Treatments were replicated three times and the site is managed under no-till.

## Results

Soil organic carbon in the 0–20 cm layer averaged 11.5 g/kg (SE 0.9) at the end
of the third season.
